units.B2: excluded: working assumption to disclose the target-protection warning boundary without promising protection; alternatives undecided (open question artifact.target-policy)

obligations.text: An ArtifactoryTarball resource downloads an archive and copies its contents to InstallDirectory during Activate.
obligations.cases: Activate with a fresh download vs no Activate phase
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: activate() records only copy_called and status; the copy target (the expanded InstallDirectory) and the copied contents are not modeled. Missing contrast at ResourceProcessor/ArtifactoryTarball.cls::OnAfterPhase: Activate copies the extracted folder into the InstallDirectory path, observed as the target files, vs a phase other than Activate leaving it unchanged.

obligations.text: During package export the resource copies its contents to the destination supplied for that resource.
Working assumption: preserve observed reuse of existing local content with no freshness guarantee.

parent.entailment: Beyond the children the parent states only the Activate copy into InstallDirectory (#1, graded directly, partial). The export copy and reuse assumption alias local-content. No composition credited.

obligations.text: Without credentials the filter must give a name or at least one @property.
obligations.cases: repo-only filter vs name filter
obligations.basis: new:iteration-75 (artifact_filter.rs exercises the property-only and repo+property filters beside the repo-only refusal over the inherited parse_fields; G4-m06 rerun as R3-m01 and the dropped property store R3-m06 are killed.) || earlier: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control repo-only-filter-admitted rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): partial, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m06, G4-m07)

obligations.text: Unsupported keys or operators fail instead of silently broadening the search.
obligations.cases: unknown key; array condition vs supported key
obligations.basis: new:iteration-75 (Neighbours assert the unknown-key refusal beside a valid name and the array refusal on supported keys; G4-m08 and G4-m09 rerun as R3-m02 and R3-m03 are killed.) || earlier: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): partial, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m08, G4-m09)

obligations.text: Allowed keys are repo, name, path, type and @property; type, when supplied, must be file.
obligations.cases: type=file vs other type value
obligations.basis: new:iteration-75 (type=file is now exercised as accepted (plain and $eq) beside the other-value refusal; G4-m10 rerun as R3-m04 is killed.) || earlier: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control nonfile-type-admitted rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): partial, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m10, G4-m11)

obligations.text: A condition is a plain value or an object with exactly one $eq; only name and path allow $match; arrays, nested operator values and multiple operators are refused.
obligations.cases: $match on repo vs name; two operators; non-text operand; array
obligations.basis: new:iteration-75 (Every condition shape is asserted on both sides; G4-m08 rerun (R3-m02) and $match allowed on every key (R3-m05) are killed.) || earlier: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; controls multi-operator-object-admitted, match-allowed-on-repository rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): partial, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m12, G4-m13, G4-m08)

obligations.text: * matches any run and ? one character; other punctuation is literal (ASCII without newlines).
obligations.cases: a* vs a.b; a?b; a.b vs axb
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; controls dot-treated-as-wildcard, star-cannot-be-empty rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m14, G4-m15, G4-m16)

obligations.text: Anonymous search keeps only results matching repository, name, path and every required property.
obligations.cases: wrong repo, wrong name, wrong path, missing property vs matching
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; guard-lost controls rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m17, G4-m18, G4-m19)

obligations.text: It takes the first result with the greatest lastUpdated text; an equal timestamp keeps the earlier result.
obligations.cases: older then newer; equal timestamps
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; controls selects-first-not-newest, tie-selects-last rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m21, G4-m22)

obligations.text: No matching result is an error.
obligations.cases: no accepted row vs one accepted row
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: newest returns None for no match, but download() takes SearchOrFetchError as an input event; no rule maps an empty selection to the error (and in developer mode to a warning). Missing contrast at ArtifactoryTarball.cls::GetArtifactPathAnonymous -> DownloadArtifact: zero matches yields an error status vs one match proceeding to fetch.

obligations.text: Each required property must occur among that result's property values; missing property data does not satisfy it.
obligations.cases: property missing vs present among several values
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control properties-guard-lost rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m23, G4-m24)

obligations.text: Scalar (non-array) property data does not satisfy a required property.
obligations.cases: property given as scalar vs array containing the value
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: Artifact.props is Map<Text,Seq<Text>>, so a scalar property value is not representable; the JSON decoding in ArtifactoryTarball.cls::HasProperties is outside the model. Missing contrast: the same value supplied as a scalar vs a one-element array, rejected vs accepted.

obligations.text: A root-level artifact uses . for path matching.
obligations.cases: root artifact with path filter "." vs nested folder
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m20, G4-m19)

obligations.text: The returned download path of a root-level artifact omits the dot folder.
obligations.cases: root vs nested artifact
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: GetArtifactPath path construction is not modeled. Missing contrast: root artifact a.tgz yields repo/a.tgz (no "./") vs nested folder yields repo/f/a.tgz.

obligations.text: With credentials IPM asks AQL to sort by decreasing update time and takes result zero without sorting or rechecking locally, so reversing the server response reverses the choice.
obligations.cases: response [old,new] vs [new,old]
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control authenticated-response-is-sorted-locally rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m25)

obligations.text: A missing ARTI_SERVER is an error outside developer mode and a warning with no download in developer mode.
obligations.cases: missing server, dev vs non-dev
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: download(MissingServer) encodes ok:dev, but only the developer-mode skip is asserted (download(true,Bearer,MissingServer).skipped); the non-dev error is never exercised by a theorem, neighbour or control. Missing contrast: download(false,_,MissingServer).ok == false beside the dev skip.

obligations.text: Developer mode also warns and skips anonymous search or fetch failures, but does not suppress authenticated failures or an extraction exception.
obligations.cases: dev anonymous vs dev authenticated vs non-dev anonymous fetch failure; dev extraction error
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; controls developer-suppresses-auth-error, developer-suppresses-extraction rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m26, G4-m27, G4-m28)

obligations.text: Skipping creates no artifact folder, and Activate then returns success without copying.
obligations.cases: skipped download vs failed download vs existing folder
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: activate() with d.skipped gives status ok and no copy, but no assertion exercises the skipped case (only the error case and the existing-folder case), and folder creation is not modeled. Missing contrast: dev missing-server skip followed by Activate: status ok, copy not called, no local folder.

obligations.text: Export still tries its copy after a skip, so the skip alone does not establish export success.
obligations.cases: export after a skipped download vs after a complete download
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: copy_export models the overlay only; ArtifactoryTarball.cls::OnExportItem after a skipped download (missing local folder) is unmodeled. Missing contrast: export after a dev skip attempts CopyDir from a missing folder and its status vs export after a complete download.

obligations.text: Extraction and copies may leave files when a later step fails, and a database rollback does not compensate them.
obligations.cases: failure after extraction/copy with transaction rollback vs success
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: No model of artifact filesystem effects under a failing later step. Missing contrast: extraction completes, a later Activate step fails and the load rolls back; the local artifact folder and copied InstallDirectory files remain.

units.B3: excluded: scope of the formal contract (first-header decision under the observed provider; no gzip, checksum, PAX or traversal claim)

obligations.text: Intended: an archive read error should fail extraction and the consuming download; success must not hide a reported stream error.
obligations.cases: first header read with error status vs successful empty read
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; C:D18: failed read returns ok in dev and non-dev; control as-built-checks-read-status rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m29)

obligations.text: As built (C:D18), a non-gzip byte sequence produces an empty read with an error status that the tar reader ignores, treating the empty header as completion, so ordinary and developer-mode anonymous downloads succeed with an empty artifact folder.
obligations.cases: failed read, dev vs non-dev
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m29)

obligations.text: A gzip stream with a nonempty header and bad checksum is refused, and a valid archive extracts its file.
obligations.cases: bad checksum vs matching checksum
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m30, G4-m31)

obligations.text: Activate reuses an existing local artifact folder without checking its contents or contacting the server.
obligations.cases: local folder present vs absent
obligations.basis: new:iteration-75 (The absent-folder request is now asserted; G4-m32 replay (R8b-m17) and a download-always mutant (R8b-m18) are killed. The model takes "copy after download" from the download result rather than a second DirectoryExists check.) || earlier: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control existing-directory-is-refetched rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): partial, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m32, G4-m33, G4-m34)

obligations.text: Export calls the download helper even when the local folder exists.
obligations.cases: export with existing local folder vs Activate with existing folder
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: Only Activate's request_download is modeled. ArtifactoryTarball.cls::OnExportItem calling RetrieveArtifact regardless of the folder is unmodeled. Missing contrast: with the folder present, export fetches while Activate does not.

obligations.text: The byte helper does not overwrite a temporary file with the same returned filename, so previous bytes can be reused after a newer response.
obligations.cases: existing temp file vs none; status 200 vs 401
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control cached-file-overwritten rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m04, G4-m05)

obligations.text: Successful copies overlay the destination: equal names are overwritten, unrelated target files remain, and other exported resources are untouched.
obligations.cases: equal name vs unrelated name; sibling resource
obligations.basis: reused:artifact-download metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control overlay-deletes-unrelated-files rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m35, G4-m36)

obligations.text: The caller builds the export destination from the module or dependency location and the resource's relative path; the processor does not choose the package root.
obligations.cases: module vs dependency export; relative path variants
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: Lifecycle/Base.cls::ExportSingleModule destination construction is unmodeled. Missing contrast: exporting the parent and a dependency places each artifact under its own module location plus the resource's relative path.
